stories.headline: Superbubble in the Large Magellanic Cloud
stories.summary: NASA’s Hubble Space Telescope captured the nebula N44, featuring a vast superbubble spanning about 210 by 140 light-years. The image reveals dense shells of gas blown by massive stars.
stories.why_it_matters: Studying superbubbles enhances understanding of stellar life cycles and galactic evolution.
